rows.headline: The Exchange has sought clarification from AVT Natural Products Ltd on October 12, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
rows.subject: Clarification sought from AVT Natural Products Ltd
rows.title: The Exchange has sought clarification from AVT Natural Products Ltd on October 12, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
Spurt in Volume
rows.summary: Significant increase in volume has been observed in AVT Natural Products Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. AVT Natural Products Limited has submitted their response.
